question_text: Maria witnessed a robbery and agreed to testify against the accused. She was admitted into the Witness Protection Program (WPP) under RA 6981. Which of the following is a benefit she is entitled to as a protected witness?

options.text: Automatic relocation to a new residence of her choice anywhere in the Philippines

Security protection and reasonable expenses for transportation and subsistence
Immunity from all criminal and civil liability arising from the incident
